description: Returns a ready-to-use inspection checklist for a type of equipment or inspection: daily pre-use, DOT pre-trip, DOT annual, forklift, aerial and scissor lifts (ANSI A92), telehandler (ANSI/ITSDF B56.6), crane, trench, scaffold, harness, ladder, rigging, fire extinguisher, skid steer, excavator, backhoe, wheel loader, dozer, compactor, compressor, generator and more.

equipment.description: Equipment or inspection type, e.g. 'telehandler', 'skid steer', 'dump truck pre-trip'

when.description: Optional timing, e.g. daily, pre-trip, weekly, monthly, annual

name: inspection_checklist
title: Inspection checklist
